thread:
marta-support: Heads-up — enterprise customer (AcmeMobile) reports repeated mid-stream disconnects when users roam from corporate WiFi to a personal hotspot. Large responses (>1k tokens) get truncated ~80% of the time, client shows EOF, and customer claims partial billing + occasional duplicate billing. Attaching short app logs and repro steps.

ryan-engr: Can you paste the raw app logs and any proxy/nginx lines? Curious if we see 499s or TCP RSTs.

marta-support: Paste from their app: 
```
[2026-03-15T18:12:03Z] SSE: recv 0 bytes, error: ECONNRESET
[2026-03-15T18:12:03Z] HTTP: 200 chunked -> stream ended unexpectedly
[2026-03-15T18:12:03Z] SDK: got partial event { \"choices\": [...], \"done\": false }
```

shaun-mobile: Repro steps? Which OS/version and SDK?

marta-support: Repro (from customer):
1) iPhone 13, app v4.2.1, connect to streaming endpoint over corporate WiFi
2) Start a long streaming generation (~2000 tokens)
3) Within ~3-7s flip to phone personal hotspot (Android hotspot) or switch SSID; stream ends immediately, app reports 'connection lost' and no final event arrives
4) Billing shows partial tokens billed, and sometimes they retried and got billed again

ryan-engr: Do they rotate tokens midstream or sit behind a proxy that reauths connections? Also any CDN in front? 499s indicate client closed.

marta-support: They use CloudCorp SSO + corporate proxy (CorpProxy v2). Token TTL is 5m, token refresh happens once during the long stream. Proxy logs show repeated RSTs to external IPs during roaming windows.

sophie-sre: Deploy bot shows no upstream 5xxs at our edge for the times mentioned. We do have streaming keepalive set — what interval are they seeing? If the app is backgrounded iOS will aggressively kill sockets on network changes.

marta-support: Quick curl test we asked them to run:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/stream?model=gpt-xyz" -v
```
When they run from laptop and toggle network adapter it reproduces. Nginx logs show several 499s and some `connection reset by peer`.

ryan-engr: 499 == client closed the connection. Two main hypotheses: 1) OS/network stack tears down socket during NAT rebinding (RST) 2) Proxy/NAT sends RST during roaming causing immediate abort. Need pcap to differentiate FIN vs RST.

sophie-sre: Ask for a tcpdump capture during repro and for the app to log connectivity events (SSID change, cellular attach). Also confirm if their proxy rewrites keepalive or enforces timeouts.

marta-support: Customer says they don't see keepalives from our side. Are we sending SSE keepalive pings?

deploy-bot: Streaming runtime settings: keepalive interval = 30s, connection idle TTL = 120s. (internal svc config id: runtime-stream-v3)

shaun-mobile: Many mobile NATs drop mappings within 10-15s of inactivity during roaming. 30s keepalive is probably too sparse. Client should also implement aggressive reconnect + resume.

ryan-engr: Short-term mitigation: recommend the app use automatic reconnect with idempotency keys or a resume token, and server-side dedupe for billing. Long-term: consider prefix/KV checkpointing so long responses can be resumed mid-output rather than restarted. Also evaluate lowering keepalive to 10s for mobile region or enable path MTU/keepalive tuning for affected customers.

sophie-sre: I'll spin up a runbook and add network-tracing steps: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/stream-reconnect (internal).

marta-support: Sent the repro checklist to customer and requested pcap + app-level network events. Also asked them to hold off on billing charges while we investigate.

support-bot: Ticket #45321 created, billing hold applied (status: pending-investigation).

alex-cs: Please CC me on updates; customer is on an enterprise contract and is escalated.

marta-support: Will do — thanks everyone. Will post pcap once they upload. :thumbsup:
